question: Model the conditional quantiles (tau=0.1, 0.5, 0.9) of inflammatory marker IL-6 using relative abundances of 500 gut microbiome taxa. Apply centered log-ratio (clr) transformation to microbiome data and use elastic net penalized quantile regression. Report which microbial taxa are associated with extremely high IL-6 levels (tau=0.9) but not with average levels.

expected_output.guidelines: At least 60% of reported taxa must be present in the reference set with matching coefficient signs; column order, row order, and header labels may differ.
